description: Fork of exp535 (soft-anchor-pair, directed-gradient = data-driven pair sampling). SINGLE change: anchor_anneal_frac 0.8 -> 0.3 (faster tau anneal). exp535 diagnosis: with anneal over 80% of training, tau stays high too long (~0.38 @ 1600, ~0.14 @ 3200) so the bits stay mushy (d=a-b small) through the whole high-LR phase -> soft gap vs exp530 WIDENED (+0.024 @200 -> +0.042 @400 -> +0.041 @600) and the hard model never transferred. Fix: anneal tau 1.0->0.02 over the FIRST 30% (reach 0.02 by step ~2400, then hold), so bit-sharpening OVERLAPS peak weight-LR (lr_scale ~0.89 at step 2400). Schedule becomes explore-then-commit: anchors (pairs) learned in steps ~1-2400 while tau is moderate, then frozen (one-hot, near-zero softmax Jacobian) and weights refine against the LEARNED HARD pairs for the remaining 5600 steps -- like exp530 but with learned instead of canonical-coverage pairs. Everything else identical to exp535. Watch: does the soft gap close and soft<->hard converge by mid-run? vs exp530 1.4731, exp535 (slow anneal), exp534 (~+0.026 undirected).
